programmes.amount_note: Long-term development loans for RDI, digital and green transition investments at favourable rates; amount set case by case.

programmes.name_local: P2 – Spodbude za zagon inovativnih podjetij
programmes.name_en: P2 – Incentives for start-up of innovative companies
programmes.amount_note: Up to EUR 72,000 per company paid in three tranches: EUR 12,000 (by 31 July 2026), EUR 21,000 (by 28 February 2027) and EUR 39,000 (by 31 March 2028).
programmes.deadline_note: P2 2026 was open to companies established between 1 January 2025 and 28 February 2026; applications have moved to the final verification stage.
programmes.reopen_note: SPS has published a P2 call annually; the next round is expected in the SPS annual programme of calls (Razpisi Slovenskega podjetniškega sklada), typically announced in January/February.

procedure_steps.detail: Confirm the company was established within the eligibility window and is a Slovenian d.o.o.
Prepare the business plan aligned with the S5 smart specialisation strategy
Submit the application to Slovenski podjetniški sklad by the call deadline
If selected, meet the milestones for each of the three payment tranches

eligibility.other_note: Must be a d.o.o. registered in Slovenia with an active business account at a Slovenian bank; product/service must align with Slovenia's S5 smart specialisation strategy. Co-funded by the ERDF under the RazvojniPlus programme.

programmes.source_snippet: Podjetja lahko v okviru razpisa pridobijo do 72.000 EUR nepovratnih sredstev ... v višini 12.000 EUR, 21.000 EUR in 39.000 EUR

programmes.amount_note: Direct SPS micro-credit EUR 5,000 to 25,000, 100% cover of eligible costs; term 2-5 years, moratorium 1-6 months, interest 37.5% of 6-month EURIBOR + 0.8% fixed margin; no processing fees; secured with 8 promissory notes; de minimis aid. EUR 10 million allocated.
programmes.deadline_note: P7-2 2026 micro-credit call (published 8 May 2026) closed 29 May 2026 at 14:00; an earlier P7 2026 call was published in January 2026. Applications via SPS ePortal.

eligibility.other_note: Micro, small or medium enterprise seated in Slovenia (company, sole trader or co-operative), at least 1 full-time employee, established before 1 Jan 2025 and operating under same tax number for at least 6 months, not in difficulty, de minimis aid.

programmes.source_snippet: Neposreden mikrokredit SPS od 5.000 do 25.000 EUR mikrokredita pod ugodnimi posojilnimi pogoji

programmes.name_local: SK75 – Konvertibilno posojilo za zagonska podjetja
programmes.amount_note: Convertible loan of up to EUR 75,000 for innovative startups, convertible into equity under defined conditions.
programmes.deadline_note: Ended: SK75 call stopped being implemented in 2023 (per SPS StartupPlusProgram page).
programmes.source_snippet: SK75: Spodbude za zagon inovativnih podjetij (ni več v izvajanju). Razpis SK75 se je prenehal izvajati v letu 2023.
